notes.title: Common bugs and tempoarary fixes!
notes.content:
There are some bugs in the game that I am in the middle of patching however there are some tempoarary solutions to anyone who needs it NOW! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Bug 1. Game crashes after "login" page:[/h2]
This happends when the game trys to load a steam friend that has an animated icon
To tempoararly solve this issue you can play the game while being logged out on steam so that the friends list wont load and there for wont crash.

[contains poteintal spoiler below]
[h2]Bug 2. The your_world.exe section is black! [/h2]
If you have been having issues with "your_world.exe" being blank there is a temporary solution of turning the "Antialiasing - Mode" in your Nvida control pannel to "Enhance the application settings"
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mDpw36B0/lifesaver.png[/img]

[contains spoiler below]
[h2]Bug 3. Game crahes after the game turns off your monitor.[/h2]
You can use "streamer mode" in settings to tempoararly solve this issue (once streamer mode enabled youll have to restart the game for the changes to take place)

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
[i]*patch update should roll out over the next few hours*[/i]
>     Fixed clashes with wallpaper engine (screen turning black)
>     Added setting to toggle shader used in Act 3 [this should hopefully solve the issue with act 3 being black]
>     Made crash during bedroom scene seem more intentional
>     Attempted to fix issue: crash after login
>     Added MORE warnings at start screen (epilepsy)
>     Some spelling issues
>     Attempted to fix issues with Windows 11 terminal / CMD

(Remember you can skip the intro / boot scene with SHIFT+SPACE)

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Woo! First patch since I got my pc wiped.
If there are major export issues I may have to revert.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Monitor will not turn off at house when in streamer mode.
[*] Removed fake "Kinito given permissions" pop up -> to many people thought it was a real virus lol
[*] Stutter removed after Kinito is given permission
[*] Attempted to fix issue: crash after login
[*] Attempted to fix issue: your_world.exe would be blacked out.
[/list]

notes.title: General Patch / Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed scaling issue at end of game.
Limited friend count to 25.
Fixed issues with crash startup.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed some issues people were having.
Fixed issues with streamer mode (made it block more stuff)
Fixed load issues with rendering 

General optimisation.

notes.title: Screen Size Monitor Issue fixed
notes.content: fixed issue where primary monitor screen size would be used regardless of game window size.

notes.title: KinitoPET Launched
notes.content:
Fixed Bug with screen resolution being used with the wrong screen depending on which the "primary monitor" of the device was set as.

Fixed Bug where screenshots would be scaled to the wrong monitor (caused by same issue)


Thanks for everyone supporting the launch of KinitoPET expect most bugs to be ironned out over the next week or so!

In the mean time join the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/GZfJqdM7au]discord.gg/GZfJqdM7au[/url] / if you want to report a bug.
